$source: design/BRAND.md and design/sournd Brand Pack.dc.html (the brand), plus night.md (how sournd.com and its emails apply it, added 0.2.0).

paper.use: light surface; text on petrol and raspberry buttons

ink.use: light text; text on amber and on the dark-mode primary

chalk.use: dark-mode text only, never an accent

petrol.use: THE primary accent: buttons, links, selection, focus, icon tile. Paper text on light; ink text on dark

raspberry.use: secondary accent: controls, control buttons, live states, knob pointers, fader thumbs, playhead. Never fills a surface or marks status. Paper text on it

amber.use: highlights (new, picks), never a warning. Ink text on it

logo.rule: Two petrols, never an accent colour. On dark the whole word steps up one tone together. Minimum 16px cap height; below that use the icon. Clear space equals the height of the n.

icon.rule: Identical in light and dark mode.

button.behaviour: Hover darkens the fill one step (lightens on night); pressed goes one more and drops 1px. Focus is a 2px ring, ink on light and chalk on dark, offset 3px. Disabled is a tint of the fill with muted text, never opacity. Labels are Instrument Sans 500, 15px, 44px tall.

display.use: wordmark, display, headings, subheads; never running text, labels or UI

type.night: On night: headings Bricolage Grotesque 700 in chalk; lede in text-soft; labels uppercase at 0.12em to 0.18em tracking when over a tinted rule; numbers tabular. Email headline 36/40 with -0.02em tracking.

ui.status: always a symbol and a word
ui.link: ink text with a 2px light-petrol underline, 3px offset

contrast: Ink on paper 14.1:1. Paper on light petrol 3.0:1 (below AA, kept as a brand call: buttons use 500 weight at 15px or larger). Paper on raspberry 7.4:1. Ink on amber 7.8:1. Light petrol as text on paper 3.6:1, so links are ink with a light-petrol underline. Chalk on night 15.2:1. Dark primary #6BBCC6 on night 9.4:1, ink text on it 11.9:1. Raspberry as text on paper 7.4:1; on dark use #EE8FA6.

night.note: The dark-first surfaces sournd.com and its emails sit on. Darker than the brand's night (#141A1C) so the petrol field and accents glow. Text is chalk, muted is the dark muted.

code.use: code blocks, text on a lit accent chip

text-soft.use: lede and intro text on night

email.footer: Tagline in Bricolage Grotesque 700 18px, the mission line in muted 13px, a petrol, amber, raspberry and violet rule (28, 14, 8 and 4px wide), then small print in faint 12px, then the sender line and sournd.com in muted.
email.rule: Dark only. Inline every style (clients drop stylesheets); solid colours where gradients are not drawn; fonts fall back to Avenir Next, Segoe UI, then system sans.

field.note: The lit tile field: rounded isometric tiles on a petrol blue glow that follows the pointer.
field.glow-use: radial gradient centred on the pointer, radius the longer screen side

violet.use: fourth accent: email rule, reverb, chord and pad voices. Never a button

gold.use: the played-instrument voice (synths) in the playground. Not a button or status

accent.categories-use: Effect categories on night only: section rule, number, tile glow. Text on a filled chip is the code colour (#0B0E12).
accent.tabs-use: Tab dots and active pills cycle in this order, then repeat. Active pill text is the code colour.
